# Oia
> Free, open-source AI banner maker: a desktop app (macOS & Windows) that makes sale banners, livestream overlays and presentation decks for Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop sellers, from your own product photo. 35 editable templates included; AI image generation uses your own ChatGPT plan. Vietnamese content available too.

Site: https://oia.solutions/
Repo: https://github.com/cuongducle/oia
Full content dump: https://oia.solutions/llms-full.txt

## Overviews (markdown)
- [English overview & FAQ](https://oia.solutions/index.md): key facts, price, platforms, license, exports, sizes, FAQ.
- [Tổng quan & FAQ tiếng Việt](https://oia.solutions/vi/index.md): thông tin chính bằng tiếng Việt.

## Use cases (markdown)
- [Flash-sale banner maker](https://oia.solutions/use-cases/flash-sale-banners.md): Shopee/Lazada/TikTok Shop sale banners, one-prompt repricing.
- [Livestream overlay maker](https://oia.solutions/use-cases/livestream-overlays.md): transparent 1080×1920 overlays for TikTok/Shopee Live with safe zones.
- [Presentation generator](https://oia.solutions/use-cases/presentations.md): outline-first multi-page decks, PDF/PPTX export.
- Bản tiếng Việt: [banner flash sale](https://oia.solutions/vi/use-cases/flash-sale-banners.md) · [khung livestream](https://oia.solutions/vi/use-cases/livestream-overlays.md) · [slide](https://oia.solutions/vi/use-cases/presentations.md).
